pullRequests.title: fix(port): keep Vulkan instance buffers in the frame ring
pullRequests.author: pezzadev
pullRequests.head: codex/vulkan-buffer-alignment
pullRequests.body:
Fix corrupted and disappearing Vulkan geometry by keeping instanced vertex data in the frame ring. Persistent instance buffers reproduce the failure on the AMD Radeon 780M Windows driver; per-vertex and index buffers still retain persistent storage.
Validated with the NTSC build, all 10 OpenGL/Vulkan renderer checks, 20-frame renderer replays of Veldin and Novalis, and an in-game Novalis comparison against OpenGL. Other planets and GPUs remain untested.

pullRequests.title: fix(port): the threads reading a track are stopped before the program exits
pullRequests.author: ReaperOfVeriod
pullRequests.head: fix/port-audio-readers-at-exit
pullRequests.body:
What
A music track is read and decoded on a thread of its own, and the thread was
detached: nothing waited for it. The player can close the window while a track
is being read, and the program then exits (std::exit) with that thread still
running. The static destructors take the mutex and the stream list away under
it, and the thread locks a mutex that no longer exists: a crash at quit, which
the crash handler catches and writes a report for. The launcher then says the
game stopped unexpectedly,…

frame after the transition starts. The port answered a made-up 60,000 ms
for a stream still being read and decoded on its thread (always the case
one frame in), then the real length (a few seconds). The fade…

commits.headline: feat(port): crash reports can name the moby being updated and the camera
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The Game line of crash.txt (and with it summary.txt's "Game state:" and the
launcher's copied report, which repeat that line) gains two facts when the
game knows them: ", updating moby class C [uid U] at X Y Z (0xADDRESS)" and
", camera at X Y Z". Without them the line is as before.
